newsitem.title: SPAIN: Seventeen dead in Spanish train derailment.
newsitem.headline: Seventeen dead in Spanish train derailment.

text.p: Seventeen people were killed and 50 were injured in a train derailment in northern Spain on Monday, state television reported.
Authorities said they feared some people were still trapped in the wreckage. The accident took place in the province of Navarre.
The television report said 18 of the injured were in very serious condition.
Nearly 250 passengers were on the train travelling from Barcelona to Irun on Spain's border with France.
It was not immediately known what caused the train to derail about 32 km (19 miles) from the city of Pamplona.
